WHEREAS, there are still many veterans and guerrillas
who, being otherwise entitled to said educational benefits,
failed to establish their right thereto within the period
prescribed by law;
NoW, THEREFORE, I, ELPIDIO QUIRINO, President cf the
Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by the
Constitution and laws of the Philippines, do hereby crder
that the educational benefits conferred by Republic Act
No. 65 to veterans and guerrillas shall be available to those
who signify their desire to study to the Chairman of the
Philippine Veterans Board before the end of the year 1948.
Done in the City of Manila, this ninth day of July, ir the
year of Our Lord, nineteen handred and forty-eight, and
of the Independence of the Fhilippines, the third.
-
ELPIDIO • QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
